newsitem.title: FRANCE: Aerospatiale may make joint bid for Thomson-paper.
newsitem.headline: Aerospatiale may make joint bid for Thomson-paper.

text.p: State-owned Aerospatiale and plane maker Dassault Aviation may team up with engineering group Alcatel Alsthom in a joint bid for electronics company Thomson-CSF, financial daily La Tribune Desfosses said on Wednesday.
If Thomson is sold privately, "the possibility of a joint Alcatel-Aerospatiale-Dassault offer seems to be more and more probable," the newspaper said.
It quoted a source close to the issue as saying that no formal agreement had been reached. "But an analysis of the synergies is pushing us more towards an alliance," it quoted the source as saying.

The finance ministry confirmed on Tuesday that Aerospatiale and Dassault would merge into a single company, while it also asked the privatisation commission to come up with a value for the two companies ahead of the privatisation of Aerospatiale.
The government is also separately studying the best way to sell Thomson-CSF after abandoning last year an attempt to sell parent company Thomson SA.
